title.e: The small cat and the small dog

sentences.p: zhè shì yī gè hǎo kàn de jiā.
sentences.e: This is a good-looking home.

sentences.p: jiā yǒu yī gè xiǎo māo.
sentences.e: The home has a small cat.

sentences.p: jiā yě yǒu yī gè dà gǒu.
sentences.e: The home also has a big dog.

sentences.p: xiǎo māo hěn xiǎo, yě hěn kě ài.
sentences.e: The small cat is very small, and also very cute.

sentences.p: dà gǒu hěn gāo, yě hěn gāo xìng.
sentences.e: The big dog is very tall, and also very happy.

sentences.p: měi tiān xià wǔ, tài yáng hěn hǎo.
sentences.e: Every afternoon, the sun is very good.

sentences.p: xiǎo māo hé dà gǒu yī qǐ wán.
sentences.e: The small cat and the big dog play together.

sentences.p: tā men bú shì péng yǒu ma?
sentences.e: Are they not friends?

sentences.p: bù, tā men shì hǎo péng yǒu.
sentences.e: No, they are good friends.

sentences.h: 小猫喜欢在大狗旁边睡觉。
sentences.p: xiǎo māo xǐ huān zài dà gǒu páng biān shuì jiào.
sentences.e: The small cat likes to sleep beside the big dog.

sentences.h: 大狗看小猫，觉得很高兴。
sentences.p: dà gǒu kàn xiǎo māo, jué de hěn gāo xìng.
sentences.e: The big dog looks at the small cat, and feels very happy.

sentences.p: zhǔ rén gěi tā men chī de dōng xī.
sentences.e: The owner gives them things to eat.

sentences.p: tā men chī wán yǐ hòu, jì xù zǒu.
sentences.e: After they finish eating, they continue to walk.

sentences.p: shēng huó zài zhè gè jiā zhēn kuài lè.
sentences.e: Living in this home is really happy.

sentences.p: tā men yǒng yuǎn shì hǎo péng yǒu.
sentences.e: They are forever good friends.
